name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 49 - Am 139
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 49 a. Calls on the European Court of Auditors to carry out an in-depth audit of the funds allocated to the LIFE programme, in order to assess their effectiveness, their cost-benefit ratio, and their genuine added value for the Union’s environmental objectives;
